patch.sql:
select
    distinct o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: Added DISTINCT to remove the 1,200 duplicate rows (identical across all columns) that caused the unique_stg_orders_order_key check to fail. This preserves the original column names and types while ensuring each order_key appears only once.
